selection.criterion: known-load validation case-mean physical displacement vector relative L2
selection.P1_checkpoint: same checkpoint selected by displacement; not selected by strain

units.P1: all-node recovered symmetric tensor Frobenius relative L2, tensor shear weighting 2

aggregation.mean: unweighted arithmetic mean of the 15 case relative L2 errors
aggregation.worst: maximum among the same 15 case errors

limits: Only the new fresh matched split-native zero/actual pair is compared; no historical control reused.
P1 is a corner finite-element, volume-averaged all-node proxy; it is not the sampled cell squared loss.
Single paired seed and repeatedly used development validation; no confidence interval or final-test claim.

both instantiate gate parameters, but zero disables their function/gradient while actual adds active multiplicative capacity; this is path/inductive-bias effect, not identical effective function classes or newly supplied information
Synthetic native acceptance has no physical-performance metric and is not plotted.
Rendering reads only the completed analysis JSON, without raw fields, model weights, Torch, or GPU execution.
